raison: Hatecryer : créature sans nom officiel dans le lot, nom propre ou descriptif incertain ; proposition « Cri-haineux » (titre : « Contrôle des populations : Cri-haineux (haut risque) »)
Hatecryer sans nom officiel (cf. n° 52) ; reste du texte identique aux autres quêtes de contrôle des populations
en: After the sundering of Draenor, most life was wiped out during collapse of the barrier between Draenor and the Twisting Nether and the resulting explosion. The wildlife that survived became sickly or corrupt, and many of Ner'zhul's portals were left permanently open, allowing all manner of dangerous beings to enter Outland and threaten our presence here.  The Hatecryer population is becoming a real threat. Travel to Socrethar's Seat and cull 3 of them.
